verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity documents selfie-to-document matching, and a community user confirms the selfie capture flow with in-browser image analysis. Nothing in the pack covers liveness detection or defenses against presentation attacks. Missing for 10: documented liveness detection, documented defenses against printed photos, screen replays and replayed video, depth on match methodology or thresholds, independent corroboration of anti-spoofing.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, selfie checks match the live user to the document portrait with liveness detection — documented defenses against printed photos, screens, and replayed video

citations.quote: Match government-issued photo IDs with selfies
